title: 4 Stocks You’ll Wish You Bought Before Earnings
creator: Couch Investor
summary: Couch Investor previews a pivotal earnings season (Netflix, Tesla, Meta this week; Amazon, Google, Intel, Reddit, Robinhood, SoFi and PayPal next) and picks four names he calls fairly cheap before they report. Sea Limited is first tracked here — BUY: down 31% year to date, forward P/E 21.1x, revenue growing near 35-40% and repeatedly beating revenue expectations, though free cash flow is flat and EPS misses. Alphabet is a BUY reiterated at about $343: Google Cloud grew 81.8% with expanding margins and could approach 100% growth, while heavy capex keeps free cash flow negative. Voyager Technologies is a CONDITIONAL_BUY: a small position he holds, halved from its highs at a $1.53 billion cap, unprofitable to about FY28, so the case rests entirely on execution against a huge defence/space TAM. Nebius is a BUY reiterated at $162 — he bought more last week; revenue is expected to scale from $1.3 billion towards $23 billion by FY28 as GPU spot prices rise. He closes by saying inclusion does not oblige anyone to buy before the print.

calls.price_at_call: $54.7B market cap (stated); no share price stated
calls.thesis: BUY — first tracked Couch SE call, no flip: one of four fairly cheap names to buy before earnings; oversold, down 31% YTD / ~36.5% drawdown, at the same price as two quarters ago, forward P/E 21.1x and price/FCF 12x forward despite ~35-40% revenue growth.
calls.base_case: Still a growth company run much better than 3-4 years ago, beating revenue/EBITDA expectations comfortably (last two quarters ~10% beats) even as EPS misses persist.
calls.bull_case: Growth holds at ~30%+ near term (revenue to ~$45B by FY28) and Shopee keeps gaining share against Mercado Libre, Alibaba, Amazon and Pinduoduo; a possible Garena ('Coney' in captions) spin-off surfaces value.
calls.bear_case: Free cash flow is not expected to grow much as Garena grows, EPS keeps missing, and competition stays intense in Southeast Asia, South America and Taiwan.

calls.price_at_call: ~$343 (stated, same level as before last earnings; it fell to ~$315 after that print)
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (was BUY 2026-10-13; no flip): still undervalued and 'one of the best names to own' — super-profitable core, large cash balance, a name that lets him sleep well and should exit any broad correction stronger.
calls.base_case: Revenue growth accelerates modestly to ~25% for three quarters; Google Cloud grew 81.8% last quarter to $24.7B with expanding margins, and the TPU business starts showing in early 2027.
calls.bull_case: Cloud growth could reach ~100% YoY this quarter and other segments could accelerate enough to flip free cash flow positive ahead of expectations.
calls.bear_case: Free cash flow was -$5.8B last quarter and is expected negative again (-$3.7B, then -$4.6B) on capex expected near $55.3B this quarter; EPS/FCF prints have been erratic.

calls.price_at_call: $1.53B market cap (stated); he covered it before at ~$22
calls.thesis: CONDITIONAL_BUY — speculative watchlist/small-position name (he holds a small eToro position; most recent prior tracked mention was UNCERTAIN 2026-10-16, older stance CONDITIONAL_BUY, no flip): halved from highs, back at its pre-earnings price, growth potential unchanged or better, huge TAM in defence/space with Palantir/Anduril partnerships. Worth it only if execution delivers — profitability is not the story yet.
calls.base_case: Revenue compounds from a tiny base (~$300M) towards ~$1B by FY28 on big contracts; at a $1.5B cap it only needs to become a $10B company for the investment to work well.
calls.bull_case: Like Rocket Lab and Nebius before it, a small company with strategic partnerships scales aggressively and rerates many times over.
calls.bear_case: Operating profit and free cash flow stay negative to ~FY28 (break-even at best), it has missed revenue estimates in earlier quarters, and everything depends on execution.

calls.video_title: 4 Stocks You’ll Wish You Bought Before Earnings
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated, adding (was BUY 2026-10-19; no flip): he bought more shares last week despite it already being a big position; the 43.4% drawdown is overblown, the company is better than three months ago, and it sits just under its 200-day average near oversold.
calls.base_case: Acceleration mode: revenue from $1.3B trailing to an expected ~$23B by FY28 and ~$3B operating profit, with EBITDA stepping $350M -> $670M -> $1.24B over coming quarters; spot GPU prices rose on average over the last 7 days (B300 +144%).
calls.bull_case: Estimate upgrades follow the capacity build-out and rising price per megawatt; management's fund-raising and build-out are, in his view, best in class.
calls.bear_case: Execution risk is large, capex jumps above $7B then $8.5B a quarter, the cost of capital has risen, and the near-term earnings print ($94M revenue expected) can still disappoint.
